note: Meadowbrook Area of Big Stone Lake State Park, on the Minnesota shore of Big Stone Lake about 8 miles north of Ortonville, among native prairie. Thirteen sites (3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 14, 27-31 and 33) line the lakeshore behind a fringe of trees; the boat landing, dock and beach are nearby. Generators may not be run at any time. --Claude
summary: DNR record + ReserveMN read: 37 back-in sites (33 online), 10 electric at 30 A, $24/$34 (Saturday the same), 48-ft limit, every site 34-48 ft; seasonal showers/flush toilets, vault toilets, dump. Lakeview kept (13 lakeside sites behind a continuous shoreline tree fringe). DNR link 404s -> spk00115. Campground closed for the year as of Nov 2026; no season dates published.
flags: WEBSITE: first line https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state_parks/big_stone_lake.html (now 404) -> https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-parks/park.html?id=spk00115; keep the ReserveMN line https://reservemn.usedirect.com/MinnesotaWeb/#!park/111.

Waterfront: lakeview kept. DNR says 'Thirteen sites are lakeside'; ReserveMN marks 'Water Front: Yes, Big Stone Lake' on 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 14, 29, 30, 31, 33 and 35 (all '.1 mile', 9 and 14 '.5 mile'), and the DNR inset map puts 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13 and 14 (south loop, about 45.3863,-96.5369) and 27-31 and 33 (west loop, about 45.3873,-96.5391) on the shore side. Zoom-19 imagery shows a continuous band of shoreline trees, roughly 15-40 m deep, between every spur end and the water at both loops, with no open ground to the lake. All are sold by the night.

Status/season: DNR (2026-11) says 'Campground is CLOSED for the Year', 'Shower Building is CLOSED for the Year', 'Dump station ... CLOSED for the Year' and 'Water is OFF for the 2026 season'. That reads as the normal winter shutdown, but the water wording could mean water was off all 2026; not written. No opening or closing dates are published, so season is left absent.
Site lengths: ReserveMN gives 12 units exactly 35 ft and the rest 34-48 ft, a spread that does not look like a uniform placeholder; DNR says 'Average site length is 40 feet'.
Online count: 33 web units (24 non-electric, 9 electric) against DNR's 37 sites and 10 electric; 19E is marked HOST on the DNR map, and 16, 20 and 34 are not offered online.
Pin 45.3868,-96.5382 is about 45 m from the ReserveMN facility point 45.38700,-96.53772, between the loops; no move needed. Phone 320-839-3663 confirmed.
